VBO:0200206.summary: The Bouvier des Flandres and Bouvier des Ardennes are distinct cattle-dog breeds. This group brings together those named Bouviers; the Flandres breed also worked as a farm draught dog.
VBO:0200206.shortDescription: The Flandres and Ardennes Bouviers are distinct cattle-dog breeds with working farm histories.
